units.source_text: 看了两人所用的时间，至七月十六日的第四轮续弈，合计白子用时四小时三十八分，黑子用时六小时五十二分。

en.t: Looking at the time used by the two players, by the fourth resumed session on July 16, White had used a total of four hours and thirty eight minutes, while Black had used six hours and fifty two minutes.

units.source_text: 至七月二十一日的第五轮续弈，白子用时五小时五十七分，黑子用时十小时二十八分。

en.t: By the fifth resumed session on July 21, White had used five hours and fifty seven minutes, while Black had used ten hours and twenty eight minutes.
On that day, the gap widened.
